text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ryan is now quite popular, and the world around her seems to be changing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In response to the support of her fans, she says that she wants to win both the Takarazuka Kinen and the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: First up is the Takarazuka Kinen, where her rematch with Mejiro McQueen is fast approaching.
